page: Microsoft Azure NV6s_v2 is a virtualized server instance belonging to the NVSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel processor with 6 dedicated vCPUs and 112.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 18.67 GB per vCPU. The hardware configuration includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 GPUs, alongside 754 GB of local SSD storage.

This instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance storage options. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The local SSD storage provides 754 GB of capacity directly attached to the instance, which supports workloads requiring fast temporary storage.

Given the combination of a fractional GPU, high memory density, and dedicated Intel vCPUs, the NV6s_v2 is structured for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand a full dedicated GPU board. This resource allocation offers a qualitative cost-efficiency advantage for entry-level visualization, moderate machine learning inference, and memory-heavy database workloads that benefit from GPU-assisted processing without the overhead of a whole GPU.
